jobs.title: Business AI Operations Specialist
jobs.jd_full:
About Us:

Spreedly is the world's leading Open Payments Platform. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Durham, NC, the company gives mid-market and enterprise businesses the infrastructure to connect to any payment gateway, processor, or fraud tool through a single API. The platform is vendor-agnostic by design, meaning customers are never locked into a single provider and never need to rebuild their payments stack to access new capabilities.

The core business problem Spreedly solves is real and costly: global merchants face a fragmented payments ecosystem, where every new market, payment method, or fraud tool typically requires a separate, time-consuming integration. Spreedly eliminates that complexity, enabling companies to route transactions intelligently, secure cardholder data, prevent fraud, and expand into new markets without heavy engineering overhead.

About the Role:

We're looking for a Business AI Operations Specialist to help Spreedly transform how business teams operate by identifying high-value opportunities and translating them into practical, scalable AI-enabled workflows.

This role leads AI workflow discovery across R&D and builds prioritized solutions across R&D and other business functions. It also owns key Marketing Operations activities outside of scoring, routing, and analytics, which are managed by Revenue Operations.

The ideal candidate combines strong operational judgment with hands-on implementation skills. They can understand how work happens today, identify opportunities for meaningful improvement, and deliver practical solutions that teams adopt and continue to use.

Success in this role will be measured by the on-time delivery of prioritized workflows, improved operational efficiency, strong adoption, measurable business outcomes, and reliable processes and solutions.

Responsibilities:

R&D Workflow Discovery

  • Lead AI workflow discovery across Product, Engineering, and other R&D functions.
  • Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs, operational challenges, and existing processes.
  • Identify opportunities where AI and automation can reduce manual work, improve execution, or increase productivity.
  • Document and maintain identified R&D opportunities in the shared company AI workflow inventory for prioritization.
  • Translate selected opportunities into clear requirements, success measures, and implementation plans.

Business AI Execution

  • Design and build prioritized AI workflows across R&D and other business functions.
  • Translate business requirements into practical solutions using approved AI platforms and shared capabilities.
  • Deliver assigned solutions on time and communicate risks or delays early.
  • Focus primarily on operational AI workflows that can deliver measurable business value.
  • Test solutions with business users, incorporate feedback, and support successful adoption.
  • Partner with the AI Enablement & Solutions Lead when initiatives require advanced architecture, reusable capabilities, or complex cross-functional design.
  • Apply shared AI standards and recommended implementation patterns to assigned solutions.

Solution Ownership

  • Serve as the AI build owner for assigned workflows.
  • Own solution design, development, testing, launch, maintenance, and ongoing optimization.
  • Partner with internal business customers to validate requirements, support adoption, and measure business outcomes.
  • Develop documentation, user guidance, and training materials for delivered solutions.
  • Monitor solution performance and identify opportunities for continued improvement.
  • Ensure assigned workflows remain aligned with shared AI standards and company priorities.

Marketing Operations

  • Own Marketing Operations activities outside of scoring, routing, and analytics.
  • Manage campaign operations and configuration, nurture programs, audience segmentation, webinars, and marketing automation.
  • Support data quality, source management, auditing, lead-flow execution, and operational governance in partnership with Revenue Operations.
  • Optimize the marketing technology stack, including HubSpot, Salesforce, Influ2, and related platforms.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations on processes and systems involving scoring, routing, analytics, and reporting.
  • Ensure Marketing Operations processes and workflows remain scalable, reliable, and well maintained.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in Business Operations, Marketing Operations, process improvement, automation, or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience designing, implementing, and maintaining operational workflows.
  • Experience using Claude or similar tools to build AI-enabled business workflows.
  • Experience with APIs, low-code or no-code platforms, workflow automation, or prompt engineering.
  • Experience applying AI or automation to improve business processes and productivity.
  • Strong ability to translate business needs into practical, usable solutions.
  • Experience with business systems, workflow automation, and modern technology platforms.
  • Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, or comparable business platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive adoption and organizational change without direct authority.
  • Strong analytical, project-management, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities across different business functions.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to reliable, maintainable execution.

Additional Skills We Value:

  • Experience with n8n, Apollo, Clay, Influ2, or similar platforms.
  • Experience supporting Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, or Revenue Operations.
  • Experience with SQL, reporting, analytics, or data visualization.
  • Experience in SaaS, fintech, payments, or another technology environment.
  • Experience supporting AI workflow discovery or business process redesign.

We Offer Our US-Based Employees:

  • Competitive salary + Equity
  • Outstanding Medical and Dental benefits, including 100% employer-paid options
  • Company-paid Life and Disability insurance
  • Optional vision and supplemental insurance options, and various Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Open Paid Time Off policy + 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents
  • Matching 401(k) plan (5% up to $5,000 yearly)
  • $1,000 annual professional development stipend
  • Monthly home working/digital lifestyle stipend, new MacBook, and one-time accessory reimbursement
  • Access to company-paid professional coaching service
  • Visits to HQ in Durham, North Carolina for remote employees

Compensation

Additional Information

#LI-AE1

Spreedly Product Offering:

Spreedly provides an open payments platform. The platform’s connectivity provides payments performance. Key products and services include:

Connect — A unified API that integrates with hundreds of payment gateways, processors, and alternative payment methods worldwide, including digital wallets. Merchants access the global payments ecosystem through one connection.
Vault — A PCI-compliant secure repository for payment methods. Merchants store card data once and reuse it across any payment service, reducing PCI scope and protecting cardholder data at scale.
Optimize — Workflow-driven routing and retry logic that directs each transaction to the best-performing gateway in real time. On average, 7.9% of failed transactions succeed immediately when retried on a secondary gateway. This is where merchants recover lost revenue and increase authorization success rates.
Protect — A flexible fraud and authentication layer, incorporating advanced fraud tools and 3DS. Following Spreedly's acquisition of Dodgeball in September 2025, fraud orchestration and payment optimization now operate within the same platform.
Resolve — Centralized management and reporting that reduces operational silos, strengthens security, and improves billing control across a merchant's entire payment operation.
More Coming Soon! - Keep your eyes peeled for a new product launch by EOY '26

--

What It's Like to Work Here:

We describe our team as "Spreedlings": diverse, forward-thinking, and driven by a shared belief that a more open payments ecosystem benefits everyone. The company operates with a culture built on transparency, courageous collaboration, and self-driven leadership. The team values simplicity in both product and process, and approaches problem-solving with genuine curiosity.

--

We champion the ethical, creative use of AI—if you’re someone who pairs human judgment with modern AI tools to work smarter and drive bigger impact, you’ll thrive here.

--

Spreedly is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We actively work to drive out even unintentional discrimination in our hiring processes via practices like blindly graded work samples, structured interviews, and diversity awareness training.

Due to the sensitive nature of what Spreedly does - handling payment data - finalist candidates must complete a successful background and reference check.

At this time Spreedly is unable to provide sponsorship for employment, and we are not set up to support remote employees who reside in New York. In order to be considered for employment, applicants must be currently legally authorized to work in the job location country and not require future sponsorship in order to continue working in that country.

We appreciate your interest in our company. Because of the high volume of resume flow, we may only respond to those candidates that we think will be a potential fit.

--

jobs.title: Senior Associate Project Manager​ - Creative Ops
jobs.jd_full:
WHO ARE WE?

We are the VMS Co-Op, a group of fast growing companies in the Vitamins, Minerals and Supplements (VMS) space. The VMS Co-Op includes OLLY, SmartyPants and future acquisitions to come! This position’s home company is OLLY.​

THE ROLE: SENIOR ASSOCIATE PROJECT MANAGER ​

The Sr. Associate Project Manager plays a critical role in supporting the successful planning and execution of creative initiatives across Campaigns, Brand,Packaging, and Innovation. Working closely with Creative, Marketing, Brand Strategy, Commercial, Product Development, Regulatory, and Operations teams, this role helps ensure projects move efficiently from intake through delivery.​

This position serves as a key operational partner to the Creative team, managing day-to-day project coordination, timelines, communications, and processes that keep work moving forward. By driving operational excellence across a portfolio of projects, the Sr. Associate Project Manager enables creative teams to focus on delivering impactful work while building the skills and experience necessary to grow into larger project leadership responsibilities.​

This role reports to Sr. Manager of Creative Operations.​

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: ​

  • Support the management of creative projects from intake through final delivery across Campaigns, Packaging, and Brand initiatives.​
  • Build and maintain project timelines, workbacks, trackers, and project documentation.​
  • Coordinate project kickoffs, status meetings, reviews, approvals, and stakeholder communications.​
  • Track project progress and proactively identify risks, dependencies, and potential roadblocks.​
  • Ensure project information, timelines, assets, and deliverables are accurate, organized, and up to date.​
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to gather requirements, align expectations, and support project execution.​
  • Assist with intake management, project routing, and workflow coordination across the Creative team.​
  • Support resource tracking and workload planning to help balance team capacity and project needs.​
  • Maintain project management systems and reporting tools that provide visibility into active work streams.​
  • Help identify opportunities to improve processes, workflows, and team efficiency.​
  • Partner with Sr. Project Managers and Creative Operations leaders to support portfolio management and operational excellence.​
  • Contribute to a collaborative, solutions-oriented culture that helps teams do their best work.​

​ THE CANDIDATE - You’re a detail-oriented project manager with a passion for creative excellence. ​​ ​

You enjoy being at the center of the action, helping teams stay organized, informed, and focused on what matters most. You’re highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive, with a passion for making complex projects feel manageable.​

You thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy collaborating across teams, and know how to keep multiple work streams moving simultaneously. You’re comfortable balancing competing priorities, communicating with a variety of stakeholders, and finding solutions when challenges arise.​

Most importantly, you’re someone who takes ownership, follows through, and genuinely enjoys helping teams work more effectively together.​

CAPABILITIES + SKILLS REQUIRED ​

  • 2-5+ years of experience in project management, creative operations, marketing operations, or related fields.​
  • Experience supporting integrated marketing campaigns, creative development, or brand initiatives.​
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.​
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.​
  • Experience building and maintaining timelines, trackers, project plans, and documentation.​
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple moving pieces with accuracy.​
  • Ability to identify risks, dependencies, and opportunities for process improvement.​
  • Experience working with project management tools and systems.​
  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to build relationships across functions.​
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.​
  • Proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with strong follow-through and accountability.​
  • Desire to grow into larger project leadership and operational management responsibilities.​

​ WHAT TO EXPECT DURING THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Initial video screen with a member of our Talent team
  • Round 1: Conversation with the Hiring Manager + 1-2 conversations with other Ollies on the team
  • Round 2: 2-3 conversations with team or cross functional Ollies
  • Final Round: Homework*

*At OLLY, our final round is called Homework. Candidates who participate in this round are given 3 questions in advance to answer and present to the interview panel they previously spoke with in the process. We understand every candidate is different. If you need a reasonable accommodation to adjust this procedure, please let us know as soon as possible so that we can evaluate and provide other options that work for your needs

THE DETAILS

​LOCATION: Remote, USA - 4X travel per year to company offsites​

HOURS: Full time, exempt (salary)

MANAGER: Sr. Manager of Creative Operations​

PLEASE NOTE: Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

WHAT WE OFFER:

  • An opportunity to work with an intelligent, inspiring, and extraordinarily fun team
  • We pay 100% of the premiums for employee-only medical, dental + orthodontics, and vision insurance
  • 4 weeks PTO + paid holidays + 12 Mental Health Days per year
  • 100% Paid parental leave, Fertility + Adoption Benefits
  • Annual Bonus

jobs.title: Packaging Program Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Ro is a direct-to-patient healthcare company with a mission of helping patients achieve their health goals by delivering the easiest, most effective care possible. Ro is the only company to offer nationwide telehealth, labs, and pharmacy services. This is enabled by Ro’s vertically integrated platform that helps patients achieve their goals through a convenient, end-to-end healthcare experience spanning from diagnosis, to delivery of medication, to ongoing care. Since 2017, Ro has helped millions of patients in nearly every single county in the United States, including 99% of primary care deserts.

Ro is consistently recognized as a top workplace in Health Care, in New York, and for Women and Parents—earning more than 20 honors from Fortune, Great Place to Work, and PEOPLE since 2021. In 2025 alone, we ranked top 5 among medium workplaces in Health Care and New York, and top 50 nationwide.

The Role:

As Packaging Program Manager at Ro, you’ll own the execution of packaging initiatives, coordinating across functions to move decisions efficiently from concept through implementation.

This is a highly cross-functional and highly visible role that sits at the intersection of operations, product, brand, and quality. You will be responsible for translating business needs into scalable packaging solutions, driving alignment among stakeholders with competing priorities, and ensuring execution against a clear, prioritized roadmap. Success in this role requires the ability to operate in ambiguity, make structured tradeoffs, and drive decisions forward in a fast-moving, multi-stakeholder environment.

You’ll work across Pharmacy Operations, Product Development, Corporate Quality, Sourcing, Supply Planning, Brand, Product Marketing, and external vendors to deliver packaging solutions that improve patient experience while supporting operational scale.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead day-to-day execution of packaging initiatives from concept through implementation.
  • Coordinate cross-functional workstreams across Pharmacy Operations, Product Development, Corporate Quality, Brand, Product Marketing, Sourcing, Supply Planning, and external partners.
  • Identify packaging improvement opportunities and develop data-driven business cases and tradeoff recommendations for leadership review.
  • Manage packaging testing, validation, artwork change control, and implementation activities to ensure successful execution.
  • Establish and maintain packaging documentation, specifications, and other governance processes that improve consistency and scalability.
  • Identify and evaluate packaging improvement opportunities, developing business cases and recommendations based on operational, financial, and patient impact.
  • Partner with external packaging suppliers, testing laboratories, and engineering partners to develop, validate, and implement packaging solutions.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • 5+ years of experience leading cross-functional programs or projects in supply chain, operations, manufacturing, product commercialization, packaging, or a related field.
  • Experience working with packaging, product commercialization, manufacturing, pharmaceutical, medical device, or consumer products is required
  • Proven ability to manage multiple complex initiatives while keeping stakeholders aligned and projects moving forward.
  • Strong program and project management skills with exceptional organization and follow-through.
  • Excellent communication skills with experience presenting recommendations, tradeoffs, and project updates to cross-functional partners and leadership.
  • A structured, analytical approach to problem-solving with the ability to translate data into practical business recommendations.
  • Experience building operational workflows or driving continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Experience working with suppliers, contract manufacturers, testing laboratories, or other external partners.

We’ve Got You Covered:

  • Full medical, dental, and vision insurance + OneMedical membership
  • Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Flexible PTO
  • Wellbeing + Learning & Growth reimbursements
  • Paid parental leave + Fertility benefits
  • Pet insurance
  • Student loan refinancing
  • Virtual resources for mindfulness, counseling, and fitness

The target base salary for this position ranges from $122,400 to $140,000, in addition to a competitive equity and benefits package (as applicable). When determining compensation, we analyze and carefully consider several factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills and experience. These considerations may cause your compensation to vary.

Ro recognizes the power of in-person collaboration, while supporting the flexibility to work anywhere in the United States. For our Ro’ers in the tri-state (NY) area, you will join us at HQ on Tuesdays and Thursdays. For those outside of the tri-state area, you will be able to join in-person collaborations throughout the year (i.e., during team on-sites).

At Ro, we believe that our diverse perspectives are our biggest strengths — and that embracing them will create real change in healthcare. As an equal opportunity employer, we provide equal opportunity in all aspects of employment, including recruiting, hiring, compensation, training and promotion, termination, and any other terms and conditions of employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, familial status, age, disability and/or any other legally protected classification protected by federal, state, or local law.

See our California Privacy Policy here.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Video OTT Platform
jobs.jd_full:
Grade Level: L3

Location: Islamabad

Last date to apply: 1st September 2026

Product Manager – Video OTT Platform

A person with hands-on, commercially minded Product Manager to own product outcomes across Video OTT consumer journeys. This role sits at the center of product strategy, delivery execution, and customer experience, translating business goals into shippable roadmaps and measurable impact. You will own the end-to-end lifecycle of features spanning content discovery, subscription and payment journeys, and platform experience, delivering consistently across mobile apps, web, and TV apps while keeping delivery on track across multiple squads and vendors.

The person will work closely with cross-functional teams—including Design, Engineering, Content, Growth, Marketing, and Business, as well as external technology and payment partners—while reporting directly to the Stream Head Content, Jazz Lifestyle Ventures.

The role reports directly to the Stream Head and has 2 people reporting directly into it.

What does Product Manager do?

Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership

•         Own the product vision and roadmap for assigned Tamasha workstreams across AVOD and SVOD, aligning them to business objectives and the wider Jazz Lifestyle Ventures strategy.

•         Take features through the full product lifecycle: ideation, validation, specification, delivery, launch, measurement, and iteration.

•         Translate market, content, and user insights into prioritized, well-scoped backlogs, balancing user value, technical feasibility, and commercial return.

•         Write clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and maintain them through delivery.

Delivery & Sprint Management

•         Drive delivery governance across squads, managing dependencies, risks, timelines, and release readiness across mobile apps (iOS and Android), Web, and Smart TV / connected TV apps.

•         Run agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives) and apply waterfall or hybrid approaches where the delivery context requires it.

•         Maintain roadmaps, trackers, and delivery artifacts in Jira and Confluence, keeping backlogs groomed and stakeholders informed of status and blockers.

•         Coordinate across internal engineering teams and external vendors to ensure quality, scope, and timelines are met.

Subscription, Monetization & Payment Journeys

•         Own subscription journeys end-to-end, including free-to-paid conversion, tiering, upgrade and renewal flows, promo and voucher mechanics, and win-back experiences.

•         Optimize checkout and billing flows across payment methods, including carrier and direct-carrier billing, cards, and Mobile Financial Services (MFS) wallet integrations.

•         Partner with Growth and Business teams to improve acquisition, activation, retention, and ARPU across AVOD and SVOD models.

Customer Experience (CX) & UI/UX

•         Champion a customer-first mindset, owning the quality of the end-to-end experience from first open to habitual viewing.

•         Partner closely with Design to shape user flows, journey maps, wireframes, and prototypes, and to validate them through usability testing.

•         Use qualitative and quantitative signals, including support and CX feedback, to identify friction points and drive measurable experience improvements.

Analytics, Measurement & Experimentation

•         Define product metrics and success criteria, and instrument journeys using GA4, event tracking, and pixel integrations across web and app surfaces.

•         Analyze funnels, cohorts, and retention curves to find drop-offs and opportunities, and prioritize accordingly.

•         Design and run A/B tests and experiments, interpret results, and turn insights into product decisions.

•         Report on product performance to stakeholders and leadership with clear, data-backed narratives.

Stakeholder Management

•         Build business cases for new features and initiatives, sizing impact and effort alongside data, finance, and commercial partners.

•         Manage vendor and partner relationships, from scoping and commercials to delivery and performance.

•         Communicate product direction, trade-offs, and decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership.

•         Balance competing priorities across content, commercial, and technology stakeholders to keep the product moving.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

•         Stay current on OTT, streaming, and monetization trends across global and regional players, and bring relevant ideas to Tamasha.

•         Champion best practices in product management and delivery and foster a culture of experimentation and customer obsession.

JazzWorld is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate, support, and thrive on diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

What are we looking for and what does it require to be Product Manager?

Education:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Management Sciences, or a related field.

Experience & Skills:

•         6–8 years of product and/or delivery management experience, ideally within OTT, streaming, digital consumer products, telco, or fintech.

•         Proven track record of shipping consumer-facing digital products at scale and owning outcomes end-to-end.

•         Hands-on experience delivering across multiple surfaces: mobile apps (iOS and Android), web platforms, and connected TV / Smart TV apps.

•         Strong delivery management foundation with hands-on experience running Agile, and comfortable operating hybrid setups.

•         Practical expertise in sprint management and delivery governance using Jira and Confluence.

•         Solid grasp of UI/UX principles and a demonstrated ability to partner with Design on user-centered solutions.

•         Hands-on proficiency with Figma and other design and prototyping tools (Adobe XD, Sketch, or similar) to wireframe, review, annotate, and collaborate on designs.

•         Hands-on experience with subscription and monetization journeys, including conversion, retention, and payment flows.

•         Working knowledge of GA4, event tracking, and pixel integration, with the ability to instrument and read product funnels.

•         Strong analytical skills and comfort making data-driven decisions.

•         Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and prioritization skills.

•         Ability to work in agile, fast-paced environments and manage multiple priorities.

Good to Have

•         Experience integrating Mobile Financial Services (MFS) wallets and carrier billing into consumer payment journeys.

•         Exposure to AVOD/SVOD monetization, ad-tech, or content operations.

•         Experience managing external technology or content vendors.

•         Familiarity with the Pakistani or emerging-market digital consumer landscape.

Why Join JazzWorld?

As one of the leading employers in the country, JazzWorld epitomizes the philosophy that each JazzWorld employee is passionately living a better every day inspired and enabled by visionary leadership, a unique professional culture, a flourishing lifestyle, and continuous learning and development.

As one of the largest private sector organizations in Pakistan, our objective is to continue to change the lives of our 69 million customers for the better. This is an opportunity for someone who wants to be part of something transformative, someone who can play a critical role in driving our success. Together, we can empower millions more with the tools necessary to progress in an increasingly digital economy.

jobs.title: Product Manager, MRI AI
jobs.jd_full:
Description

The Product Manager is responsible for managing roadmaps for MRI AI products and for the delivery and continuous improvement of these products, working under the guidance of the Director of Product Management for MRI AI. The responsibilities include gathering and prioritizing product and customer requirements with internal stakeholders, contributing to the product releases and successful launches. The Product Manager will sit at the center of a cross-functional device team spanning software engineering, machine learning, clinical, QARA and technical delivery, and will keep that team clear on what we are building and, above all, why. The Product Manager will maintain the roadmap for these products, translate clinical and customer needs into requirements the team can act on, and help move releases from concept through development to launch.

Requirements

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

·       Act as the product point of contact for one or more MRI AI devices, supporting the day-to-day work of a cross-functional team.

·       Work closely with the Technical Delivery Managers to keep scope, sequencing and delivery expectations aligned.

·       Take part in agile development activities: refinement, design reviews, workshops and stakeholder demonstrations.

·       Unblock the team by chasing down answers to open clinical, product or workflow questions.

·       Articulate the problem before the solution. For every significant piece of work, be able to explain in plain language who it is for, what they are struggling with today, and what changes for them when we ship.

·       Deliver prioritized features and corresponding justification.

·       Keep stakeholders informed across the company, tailoring the message to the audience.

·       Represent the user in the room. Provide customer use cases, clinical and operational context and high-level specifications, and participate in design work, so that decisions are grounded in real user workflows.

·       Contribute to release planning and launch, working with marketing and commercial on the end-to-end launch of DeepHealth products.

·       Become an expert on the competition and the market, and share what has been learned with the team.

·       Learn the regulatory context. Understand how EU MDR and FDA requirements shape what we can build and claim, and work with QARA colleagues.

Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience

·       Curious and proactive. (Required)

·       Customer-first mindset. (Required)

·       Works well in a cross-functional team and with stakeholders at all levels. (Required)

Quality Standards

·       Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.

·       Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures.

This position requires domestic / international travel up to 10%.

Salary: 45K EURO EU

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Bastion

Bastion provides the regulated infrastructure businesses need to hold, move, and issue stablecoins. Our platform combines custodial wallets, global payment orchestration, and stablecoin issuance. Customers can use each product independently or connect them into a single end-to-end flow.

We operate through our own regulated entities, with compliance and risk controls built directly into the platform. We can also support customers operating under their own licenses with the compliance and financial operations required to run their programs.

Overview

We are looking for a Product Manager to own our Shared Services vertical, the set of foundational capabilities that every other product area at Bastion depends on. You’ll turn ambiguous, compliance-heavy problems into clear, sequenced, shippable work. You’ll own the roadmap, requirements, compliance checkpoints, quality bar, and stakeholder communication for a vertical that gates customer commitments across the platform.

Shared Services sits where product, engineering, and compliance meet. Much of the work centers on the controls and obligations that make stablecoin infrastructure trustworthy: identity and due-diligence flows, third-party risk controls, regulatory reporting, and the policies that govern how money moves.

This is a high-leverage IC role with real ownership from week one. It may be up-leveled to Senior PM depending on the candidate and interview performance.

We are open to candidates anywhere in the United States, with an advantage for those in (or willing to relocate or travel often to) New York City.

No prior experience working with stablecoins is required. We have a preference for prior experience with fintech, compliance, or risk.

Work to Be Done

Instead of a list of requirements, we want to give you a directional look into the first 30, 90, and 180 days on the job.

We are a startup, so the pace is fast and the specific work will change. People who thrive here are finding ways to contribute in their first week, and fully productive in their third month.

If you think this is something you can handle, we will be excited to speak with you.

First 30 days: Learn the vertical AND take work off the table

  • Map the Shared Services surface area: the foundational capabilities other verticals depend on, their current state, and where delivery risk is concentrated

  • Meet your partners in Engineering, Compliance, and GTM; learn the escalation paths and how Shared Services work gates commitments elsewhere

  • Take ownership of requirements for at least one active compliance-critical workstream and turn it into clear, sequenced, engineer-ready specs

  • Stand up a lightweight triage cadence so incoming requirements and issues stop piling up

  • Ship or unblock visible progress on at least one customer-gating milestone

  • Outcomes

    • A clear picture of the Shared Services roadmap and how its items gate customer commitments

    • Partners know what you own and how to route work to you

    • At least one workstream materially advanced through sharper requirements and sequencing

By 90 days: Own the roadmap and run the cadence

  • Own the Shared Services roadmap end to end: themes, sequencing, milestones, and compliance checkpoints aligned to company priorities

  • Run a predictable operating rhythm (planning, triage, risk tracking, and stakeholder updates) that Engineering and Compliance can rely on

  • Drive requirements and delivery across several concurrent regulated workstreams, holding the quality bar on each

  • Partner with Compliance to define and track checkpoints that keep flows defensible without stalling delivery

jobs.title: Deputy Program Manager / Operations Lead
jobs.jd_full:
At Team Carney, we believe that true performance acceleration happens at the intersection of innovative learning and deep strategic expertise. Since 1994, our mission has been to provide top-tier training, learning, and human capital solutions that empower Federal Government agencies to meet their critical mandates. We are seeking a results-oriented Deputy Program Manager / Operations Lead to oversee daily operational execution across enterprise learning programs supporting the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA).

This position is contingent upon award.

Work Schedule and Location

  • This position is remote with periodic on-site presence in Silver Spring, MD

  • Clearance Requirement: Current or ability to obtain Public Trust clearance required.

Who You Are & What You’ll Do

As the Deputy Program Manager / Operations Lead, you will partner directly with the Program Manager to ensure seamless day-to-day coordination, task area execution, resource allocation, and deliverable quality. You will maintain operational oversight over training intake tracking, LMS scheduling, staffing rosters, and cross-functional team workflows. You will serve as the secondary point of contact for government stakeholders and step into full leadership authority in the Program Manager’s absence, preserving continuity of operations across all contractual task areas.

What You Bring to the Table - Requirements

  • Experience: At least seven (7) years of experience in federal program or operations management, with demonstrated success managing multi-functional service delivery environments in learning, human capital, or technical fields.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business administration, education, public administration, or a related field.

  • Operational Expertise: Strong expertise in workflow coordination, schedule monitoring, risk tracking, subcontractor oversight, and quality assurance processes.

  • Stakeholder Management: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with proven ability to interface effectively with federal government representatives and cross-functional project teams.

  • Process Controls: Experience implementing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), tracking training intake metrics, and supporting monthly status reporting.

Why Join Team Carney?

When you join Team Carney, you join a legacy of excellence. We focus on our people because when we make a positive impact on the lives of our employees, they are able to make a positive impact on our clients. We offer a full suite of competitive benefits, including:

  • Health & Wellness: Multiple medical, dental, and vision insurance options (BCBS CareFirst), health spending accounts (HSA), and flexible spending accounts (FSA).

  • Financial Security: 401(k) retirement plan with company match, plus Carney-paid life and disability insurance.

  • Work-Life Harmony: Generous Paid Time Off (PTO), 11 paid holidays, and 6 weeks of paid parental leave.

  • Professional & Personal Growth: Annual tuition assistance (up to $5,000) and student loan repayment.

  • Get Out and Learn: Up to $200 annually to learn almost anything (from pottery to coding!).

  • Get Out and Run: Up to $200 annually to participate in fitness and active lifestyle events.

  • Continuous Development: Ad hoc training and ongoing professional development access.

jobs.title: Project Manager, CPG
jobs.jd_full:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

The Digital Marketing Project Manager will play an integral part in the overall success of our account team’s delivery and service to our clients, serving as the communications and coordinating hub between team members and the client.  This role will report directly into the Client Experience team,, and will be supported by Power’s Project Management Office (PMO).

This role will be an exceptional client-facing project manager, skilled at managing and delivering digital marketing deliverables and solutions from inception to completion.  They will become part of a high-performing team that gets client deliverables completed on time, on budget and with the highest standards of quality while working in a dynamic, fast-paced and forward thinking agency environment.  Working closely with clients and account teams, this role will manage multiple concurrent accounts, service lines and multi-disciplinary teams to meet our client’s strategic and tactical marketing objectives.  As a key member of the account team, this role will be proactive, have excellent communication and problem-solving skills, and be confident in your ability to meticulously organize and keep your deliverables moving forward on-time without compromising quality.  They will keep all stakeholders up to date with progress and overcoming all of the inevitable challenges along the way.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage multiple concurrent accounts, service lines, deliverables and cross-functional team members via web-based project management software (Asana) and various communication channels
  • Create and execute deliverable plans, and revise as appropriate to meet continuously changing needs and requirements
  • Oversee all aspects of deliverable management: scope, risk, schedule, quality, and communication to stakeholders’ fullest satisfaction
  • Support account calls through detailed recaps, captured action items, Asana task assignments and diligent follow-up on action items
  • Evaluate new work requests, identify resources needed, assign individual responsibilities, and schedule action items
  • Provide regular updates and progress reports to internal teams and/or client stakeholders
  • Conduct risk management and escalate internally within the account team to proactively mitigate issues
  • Identify areas for improvement with internal and external processes along with possible solutions

Role Requirements:

  • Minimum of three (3) years of experience leading projects and supporting client deliverables in a digital marketing agency environment
  • Strong proficiency with Asana as a work management platform
  • CAPM, CSM, PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP, or equivalent preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • Subject matter familiarity in digital marketing (e.g.: SEO, SEM, Content Marketing, Display, Feeds, Paid Social, Analytics, etc.)
  • Able to thrive in fast-paced environments and embrace change
  • Professional approach and comfort with conflict management and mediation
  • Ability to direct teams effectively in task prioritization and execution as well as facilitation of multiple projects simultaneously within a high-pressure environment
  • Excellent diplomatic, interpersonal, negotiation and communications skills with tenacity to solve internal and client problems quickly
  • Process driven, highly organized and methodical with excellent time management skills, strong business ethics, and political awareness
  • An enthusiastic and committed attitude, flexible problem-solver, open to participate and promote change within the organization
  • Self-starter with ability to think independently and work autonomously

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Consistent adoption of PMO templates and processes
  • Documented time savings achieved through PM task/work ownership
  • Projects/deliverables completed and delivered on-time

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Ensuring on-time delivery of all supported digital marketing deliverables
  • Establishing operational and project management best practices on supported accounts
  • Maintaining ongoing communication between the client and account team regarding the status of all projects and deliverables

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary + commission opportunities
  • Medical Bonus
  • 15 paid vacation days (PTO) per year
  • Up to 4 hours per quarter for paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO) towards philanthropic endeavors
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
  • A one time 400.000 COP Work From Home (WFH) stipend automatically added to your first paycheck
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • 17 observed Colombian national holidays + 2 mental health recharge days per year
  • Legal benefits like Prima, Cesantias
  • Paid Social Security
  • Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
  • Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
  • Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
  • Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone’s responsibility.

Please be aware of fictitious job openings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers from suspicious sources. These engagements may be an attempt to obtain private information, or to induce you to pay a fee for services related to recruitment or training. Power Digital does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fee at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process. All genuine job openings will be posted on our careers page at https://powerdigitalmarketing.com/company/careers/ . If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any messaging behalf of Power Digital, please send us an email at recruiting@powerdigital.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.
